behaviors.description: An instance ID is publicly usable immediately when its descriptor delivers it.
behaviors.preconditions: A prestarted C observer launches the CLI with an instance-ID pipe; the app cannot report readiness or exit until its stdin barrier is released.
behaviors.expected: First public get_all lookup, without polling or readiness waits, finds the exact ID, application, commit and positive live PID; releasing the barrier permits successful exit.

notes: Only public libflatpak APIs are called: flatpak_instance_new is private. This tests immediate enumeration, not every portal SpawnStarted protocol behavior, and adds no requirement denominator.
